subject: Twitchy jelly
topic: This jellyfish seems to twitch and jump as it swims.
script:
This jellyfish seems to twitch and jump as it swims.
It's a deep-sea jelly called Crossota.
Scientists watched it put on an acrobatic show while it was feeding.
Its red-orange bell is ringed with many fine tentacles.
It spends its whole life in open water, never attaching to the seafloor.
Its tentacles spread out around it like a fringe, ready to catch tiny prey.
This one was filmed in deep water off the southeastern United States.
Watching deep-sea jellies feed in the wild is rare, so every clip like this helps.
What does its dance remind you of?
